label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: A location pop-up covered the page on arrival and had to be closed before anything else could be done
Many products show a Subscribe Save button already marked as pressed, so it is unclear whether adding to cart creates a subscription; I chose a product without it

element.name: Disable subscription and save option for Bar Soap 6-Pack

findings.problem: After adding to cart the drawer showed Calculating and Adding, and the Checkout button was disabled until I re-read the page; the delay was only announced as Calculating
Product list items for ratings are empty list items with no text, so star ratings are not understandable; the same product name appears as several different links
Payment card fields sit inside separate frames and several sections repeat a Mobile phone (optional) field with the same name, which is confusing
